title: the Kerberos libraries in the PostgreSQL image
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the job log, the tree or the distribution's package lists read by the card; no image was built or scanned by the card.

findings.claim: the 15 failing findings on libkrb5-3 and libkrb5support0 1.21.3-5+deb13u1 that stop rehearse step 3 belong to trialbox-postgres:16-1 (deploy/docker/db.Dockerfile): read from the gate's image order, as the job log cuts the image line

postgresql-16 and libpq5 (and pgbackrest through libpq5) depend on libgssapi-krb5-2, which depends on libkrb5-3, libk5crypto3 and libkrb5support0: the server links Kerberos, so the packages cannot be removed; the box configures no GSSAPI authentication
trixie-security has krb5 1.21.3-5+deb13u2; db.Dockerfile installs exact versions without an upgrade, so the image keeps the base's deb13u1, unlike python.Dockerfile, which upgrades
that 1.21.3-5+deb13u2 fixes these 15 findings is inferred from the gate failing only on findings with a fixed version; no image was built or scanned with it
